# Fırat Tuna Arslan

> AI engineering student at Trabzon University and systems developer. Builds developer tools and AI pipelines in Go, Rust and Python: verified memory for coding agents, security for MCP servers, and clinical ECG models.

Open to internships and freelance work on developer tooling, backend systems and applied ML. Contact: firattunaarslan@gmail.com.

## Projects

- [aletheia](https://github.com/firatmio/aletheia): Memory for coding agents that checks itself against your code. Every memory carries evidence and is re-checked on every recall. Go, MCP server, listed in the MCP Registry as io.github.firatmio/aletheia. Website: https://aletheia.firattunaarslan.me
- [mcp-audit-proxy](https://github.com/firatmio/mcp-audit-proxy): A package-lock and flight recorder for MCP tool descriptions. Pins every tool, alarms on changes, logs every call and flags prompt injection. Local-only Go binary.
- [cardioguard-mg](https://github.com/firatmio/cardioguard-mg): Real-time Holter ECG monitoring with a CNN, a rule engine and MedGemma. Python, TypeScript, Next.js, React Native.

## Side projects

- [linkup](https://github.com/firatmio/linkup): Chat and file transfer between devices on the same local network. Rust, Tauri, React.
- [Ahar](https://github.com/firatmio/ahar-releases): A desktop app for writing documents together as a team.
- [mbpp-tr](https://github.com/firatmio/mbpp-tr): A Turkish translation of the MBPP benchmark, with LoRA fine-tunes of Qwen3-1.7B reported as a negative result. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/firatmio/mbpp-tr
- [db-viewer](https://github.com/firatmio/db-viewer): A database viewing and management tool. Tauri, TypeScript.
- [go-auth](https://github.com/firatmio/go-auth): An extensible authentication and authorization system in Go.
- [pywraps](https://github.com/firatmio/pywraps): Retry, timeout, debounce and background decorators for Python with zero dependencies.
- [reveal-animation](https://github.com/firatmio/reveal-animation): A React component that plays CSS animations as elements scroll into view.
